description: Land Title Settlement Department - Alapalawala, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320302
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, locations, and ownership details) by the Commissioner of Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership adjudication and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
